Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data

Class PropertyStore

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.PropertyStore
@Internal public final class PropertyStore extends Object
Every property of every item and block, stored once with the versions it is valid for. Immutable.

The bundled form is properties.nbt, a gzipped big endian NBT compound: 

 format: int                      1
 versions: [string]               version names, oldest first
 items: {identifier: {property: [{from: name, to: name, value: tag}]}}
 blocks: {identifier: {property: [{from: name, to: name, value: tag}]}}
 block_order: {version: [identifier]}   optional: the order BDS sends the data driven blocks of a version in
A property name is the kind prefix and the name. Ranges are inclusive, in version order, and an equal value in consecutive versions is one range. Item component data and the property compound of a data driven block are split one level deep: every entry of components is a PropertyKind.COMPONENT property, every other key a PropertyKind.WIRE property. An item or block whose compound is empty has the property #present instead, so it still exists (and is not null) when the data is put together again.

Behaviour properties (PropertyKind.BEHAVIOUR) have no producer yet. The capture of the Script API puts them in with PropertyStore.Builder.put(org.geysermc.paletter.internal.data.PropertyStore.Owner, java.lang.String, org.geysermc.paletter.property.PropertyKind, java.lang.String, org.geysermc.paletter.data.DataVersion, java.lang.Object), next to what build(List) derives from the network data.
